mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_application (application_no, medical_record_id, patient_id, doctor_id, exam_item_id, exam_item_name, item_type, apply_remark, total_amount, pay_status, status, create_time) VALUES (#{applicationNo}, #{medicalRecordId}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{examItemId}, #{examItemName}, #{itemType}, #{applyRemark}, #{totalAmount}, #{payStatus}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_application WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
SELECT * FROM exam_application WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND pay_status = 'UNPAID' ORDER BY create_time DESC
